name: parts
meaning: array of partCount hierarchy parts, 0x70 bytes each (new MeshPart[n] in AnimMesh_Load 0x40b72b-0x40b76c: count cookie, MeshPart_Ctor 0x41a070 per element); +0x04 = parent index, +0x0c = vertex count, +0x10 = part matrix, +0x14/+0x18 = the pose inputs for 0x41a4da

name: partCount
meaning: number of hierarchy parts, read from the resource by 0x41be6d

name: sequences
meaning: array of seqCount 0x14-byte sequence records; +0x0c = frame array (0xc bytes per frame, the u16 at +4 being half the frame duration in ms), +0x10 = frame count

name: seqCount
meaning: number of animation sequences, read from the resource by 0x41bf4e

name: playing
meaning: 0 means the next update does the first-frame initialisation; cleared from the loop flag when a non-looping sequence ends

name: animTimer
meaning: a privately owned Timer (operator new 0x28) that drives the animation in wall-clock milliseconds, independent of g_dt, g_timeScale and the pause flag

name: loop
meaning: 1 keeps the sequence repeating when its last frame is reached

name: blend
meaning: 1 cross-fades into a newly requested sequence using elapsedMs/frameDurationMs as the weight instead of snapping

name: currentSeq
meaning: sequence being played; -1 at construction, compared against requestedSeq to detect a change

name: frameIndex
meaning: index of the NEXT frame to apply (it is incremented immediately after each frame is applied)

name: requestedSeq
meaning: sequence requested by AnimMesh_SetSequence, latched into currentSeq by the update

name: elapsedMs
meaning: milliseconds accumulated in the current frame from the private Timer; frameDurationMs is subtracted on each advance so the remainder is carried

name: frameDurationMs
meaning: duration of the current frame, computed as 2 * (u16 at frameRecord+4), so frame times are authored in half-milliseconds
